# basic
> scenario basic 30000 1000
state alive=true active=none queued= control=0 live=1,0 metrics=0,0,0,0
> reserve S1 10 far
r S1 reserve ok t1
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=0,0,0,0
> write S1 t1 text 10 far
d frame w1 text 10 "xxxxxxxxxx" | barrier w1
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=1,10,0,0
> ack w1
r S1 write ok
state alive=true active=none queued= control=0 live=1,0 metrics=1,10,0,0
> reserve S1 5 far
r S1 reserve ok t2
state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=1,10,0,0
> write S1 t2 binary 5 far
d frame w2 binary 5 "xxxxx" | barrier w2
state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,15,0,0
> ack w2
r S1 write ok
state alive=true active=none queued= control=0 live=1,0 metrics=2,15,0,0
# queue
> scenario queue 30000 1000
state alive=true active=none queued= control=0 live=1,0 metrics=0,0,0,0
> reserve S1 10 far
r S1 reserve ok t1
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=0,0,0,0
> reserve S2 10 far
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued=p:S2:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=0,0,0,0
> reserve S3 10 far
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued=p:S2:10,p:S3:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=0,0,0,0
> write S1 t1 text 3 far
d frame w1 text 3 "xxx" | barrier w1
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued=p:S2:10,p:S3:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=1,3,0,0
> ack w1
r S1 write ok | S2 reserve ok t2
state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued=p:S3:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=1,3,0,0
> write S2 t2 text 4 far
d frame w2 text 4 "xxxx" | barrier w2
state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued=p:S3:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,7,0,0
> kill S3
state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued=p:S3:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,7,0,0
> ack w2
r S2 write ok
state alive=true active=none queued= control=0 live=1,0 metrics=2,7,0,0
> reserve S3 1 far
r S3 reserve ok t3
state alive=true active=payload:t3 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,7,0,0

> write S1 t1 text 2 far
= skip
state alive=true active=payload:t1 queued=p:S3:10 control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,2,0,0
> ack w1

state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,2,0,0
> ack w3
state alive=true active=payload:t2 queued= control=0 live=2,1 metrics=2,2,0,0
# control
> scenario control 30000 50
state alive=true active=none queued= control=0 live=1,0 metrics=0,0,0,0
> control 10
d frame w1 text 10 "cccccccccc" | barrier w1
r c1 control ok
state alive=true active=control queued= control=0 live=1,1 metrics=1,10,0,0
> control 20
r c2 control ok
state alive=true active=control queued=c:20 control=20 live=1,1 metrics=1,10,0,0
> control 20
r c3 control ok
state alive=true active=control queued=c:20,c:20 control=40 live=1,1 metrics=1,10,0,0
> ack w1
d frame w2 text 20 "cccccccccccccccccccc" | barrier w2
state alive=true active=control queued=c:20 control=20 live=1,1 metrics=2,30,0,0
> ack w2
d frame w3 text 20 "cccccccccccccccccccc" | barrier w3
state alive=true active=control queued= control=0 live=1,1 metrics=3,50,0,0
> control 30
r c4 control ok
state alive=true active=control queued=c:30 control=30 live=1,1 metrics=3,50,0,0
> control 30
d close 1013 Slow consumer
r c5 control error timeout
state alive=false active=- queued=- control=0 live=- metrics=3,50,0,1
> control 30
r c6 control error destination_closed
state alive=false active=- queued=- control=0 live=- metrics=3,50,0,1
